title: Agent-eval export tool calls section (schemaVersion 1)
description: Schema of ONE tool-call record; the file tools.jsonl carries exactly one record per line (UTF-8, LF-terminated; an empty section is a zero-byte file). Honesty rules pinned here: raw tool arguments NEVER travel — only their sha256 digest (argsDigest; null only for a call that carried no argument text at all); argument text appears verbatim ONLY as argsRedactedSafe when the producer explicitly pinned it redacted-safe. Environment references are NAME-shaped (no '=' values — a name=value pair is a schema violation); artifacts are hashes plus size, never content. denied calls carry denyReason (never plain reason); failed/uncertain calls carry a non-empty reason; succeeded/cancelled/timeout calls carry neither.

callId.description: The model call (calls.jsonl callId) that issued this tool call, or null when not attributable.

argsDigest.$comment: Pattern enforced below via allOf so the null case stays expressible.
argsDigest.description: sha256 over the raw UTF-8 argument text as received from the model; the raw text itself never appears in any export document.

argsRedactedSafe.description: Verbatim argument object ONLY when the producer explicitly pinned it redacted-safe (a deliberate, fixture-reviewable act); null otherwise. The digest above is computed over the pinned text so both views agree.

envRefs.description: Environment variable NAME references only. A name=value pair here is a contract violation: values never travel.
